content: It is not the strongest of the species that survives, nor the most intelligent; it is the one most adaptable to change.
author: Charles Darwin
story:
Preserved as part of Charles Darwin's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of evolution and science. Across his life and work, Charles Darwin returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
reflectionPrompt: What would change in your daily outlook if you truly lived by this perspective?
